pending.title: Bacterial Genomic DNA Isolation for Sequencing
pending.summary: Isolate high-molecular-weight genomic DNA from E. coli and other bacteria for Illumina or nanopore sequencing: lysozyme, SDS and proteinase K lysis, RNase A, CTAB cleanup, chloroform and phenol extraction, isopropanol precipitation, and Qubit and gel quality control.
pending.keywords: bacterial genomic DNA extraction gDNA sequencing E. coli CTAB lysozyme proteinase K high molecular weight nanopore Illumina phenol chloroform Qubit

sources.citation: Feil W, Feil H, Copeland A. Bacterial DNA isolation CTAB protocol. DOE Joint Genome Institute; 2012 (version 3).
New England Biolabs. Protocol for high molecular weight DNA (HMW DNA) extraction from bacteria (NEB #T3060); 2020.
Oxford Nanopore Technologies. Bacteria gDNA extraction for Nanopore-only Microbial Isolate Sequencing Solution (NO-MISS); published 2024.
Stöckl RRKS. HMW gDNA extraction from prokaryotic cultures and cryo preservation stocks. protocols.io; 2023. doi:10.17504/protocols.io.3byl4q7nrvo5/v1.

pending.title: C. elegans Thrashing and Locomotion Assay
pending.duration: About 4 days (3 days of worm growth, 2–3 h for the assay)
pending.summary: Count swimming thrashes of synchronized day-1 adult C. elegans in M9 buffer: bleach synchronization, bacteria clearing, a fixed acclimation time, 30 s video counts, blinded scoring, optional automated analysis and statistics.
pending.keywords: C. elegans thrashing assay locomotion swimming body bends M9 buffer neuromuscular behavior N2 synchronization levamisole video analysis

pending.title: CLIP-seq
